runs.reason: The durability power-cut fixture used unguarded POSIX unistd file IO on MSVC. The source was repaired with explicit Windows adapters and a structural regression test.
Both runs were stopped when the Windows portability fix advanced the required same-source tuple.

All sanitizer and 90-second fuzz targets passed, but Episode smoke timed out because os.tmpdir() resolved to the host mechanical disk. The identical profile passed in 109.26 seconds on repository-scoped NVMe temporary storage.
